meta.name: azure-kubernetes
meta.description: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters. Covers Day-0 checklist, SKU selection (Automatic vs Standard), networking options (private API server, Azure CNI Overlay, egress configuration), security, and operations (autoscaling, upgrade strategy, cost analysis). WHEN: create AKS environment, provision AKS, enable AKS observability, design AKS networking, choose AKS SKU, secure AKS, optimize AKS, AKS spot nodes, AKS cluster-autoscaler, rightsize AKS pod, pod rightsizing, over-provisioned AKS pod, pod resource requests and limits, Vertical Pod Autoscaler, VPA recommendations.

copy.tagline: 规划、创建并配置生产就绪的 AKS 集群。

copy.tagline_en: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes clusters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning to set up production-grade Kubernetes clusters on Azure.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会规划并推荐 AKS 集群配置，涵盖 SKU 选择、网络、安全、可观测性、升级与成本，区分 Day-0 与 Day-1 决策。
howto.when: 当你说“创建 AKS 环境”“设计 AKS 网络”“启用 AKS 可观测性”等关键词，或要求规划、创建、优化 AKS 集群时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划生产级 AKS 集群，该选 Automatic 还是 Standard？
say.note: Claude 会基于你的需求给出 SKU 建议并说明理由。

say.text: 启用 AKS 自动扩缩容并优化成本，该用什么配置？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude plans AKS cluster configurations based on user needs: SKU selection, networking, security, observability, upgrades, cost; distinguishes Day-0 vs Day-1 decisions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like 'create AKS environment', 'design AKS networking', 'enable AKS observability', or ask to plan/create/optimize AKS clusters.

say_en.text: Help me plan a production AKS cluster. Should I choose Automatic or Standard?
say_en.note: Claude suggests a SKU based on your needs.

say_en.text: Design AKS networking and compare Azure CNI Overlay vs VNet-routable.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the two pod IP models.

say_en.text: Enable AKS autoscaling and optimize cost. What configuration should I use?
say_en.note: Claude recommends Node Auto Provisioning and Spot nodes.
